The Amazon Black Friday Sale is in full swing, and with it comes a large amount of tool deals, some of which are featured below, while the rest can all be found within our Black Friday Green Deals hub . There’s an autonomous upgrade in the Mammotion 2026 LUBA Mini 2 AWD 1500H Robot Lawn Mower down at a new $1,599 low – which is bundled with a cleaning stand – alongside its counterparts. We’ve also got EGO’s Multi-Head 15-inch String Trimmer Combo Kit at a $300 low alongside other rounded up tools, as well as the brand’s Portable Area Light at $119 . There’s also Greenworks’ 80V 10-inch Cordless Pole Saw at the best price in eight months, the Worx Pegasus 2-in-1 Folding Workbench/Sawhorse at $100 , and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Mammotion’s robot lawn mowers up to 34% off: LUBA Mini 2 AWD 1500H + cleaning stand at new $1,599 low ($479 off), more
During Amazon’s Black Friday Sale event , you can currently find Mammotion robot mowers with up to 34% discounts, starting with the 2026 LUBA Mini 2 AWD 1500H Robot Lawn Mower with a cleaning stand at $1,599 shipped . Down from $1,999, we’ve only previously seen this mower drop as low as $1,699 during October’s Prime Day event. For Black Friday, though, you’re getting an even larger $400 markdown, not to mention the FREE cleaning stand included ($79 value), landing things at a new all-time low price. You can also find it with a garage attachment for its dock station at $1,728 shipped , while the brand’s other models have been rounded up for you below.
LUBA Mini 2 AWD 1500H: $1,599 (Reg. $1,999)
LUBA Mini 2 AWD 1500H with garage: $1,728 (Reg. $2,057)
LUBA 2 AWD 3000X with replacement blade set: $1,928 (Reg. $2,399)
LUBA 2 AWD 3000HX: $1,998 (Reg. $2,378)
LUBA 2 AWD 5000HX: $2,299 (Reg. $3,499)
EGO’s 56V 15-inch Multi-Head string trimmer combo kit returns to $300 2026 low with Black Friday savings, more
As part of Amazon’s Black Friday Sale event , you can find some solid EGO Power+ tool deals worth jumping on, like the EGO Power+ 56V Multi-Head Combo with Power Head, 15-inch String Trimmer attachment, and a 5.0Ah battery at $299.99 shipped . Down from $389, we’ve mostly seen discounts keep the price between $339 and $319 in 2026, though there were drops to $300 during both Prime Day events. Now, you’re getting a third annual chance at the best price of the year, saving you $89 off the going rate.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
You can browse all the rounded up EGO tool deals accompanying this combo kit right here .
Use EGO batteries to power this foldable portable area light, which also doubles as a power bank for $119 ($60 off)
As part of the ongoing Amazon Black Friday Sale , you can find the EGO Power+ Portable Area Light down at $119 shipped . Down from $179, since mid-July we’ve only seen it dropping to $160, with discounts before that having mostly kept things above $129, though there were some dips as low as $114, which was a one-time fall during June’s Prime Day event. The deal here cuts $60 from the tag, giving you the second-lowest price of the year – just $5 above this year’s low.
Greenworks arsenals can add this 80V 10-inch cordless pole saw to its ranks at $141 ($49 off, best in eight months)
Amazon is currently offering Greenworks tool owners a tool-only deal for the Gen 1 80V 10-inch Cordless Electric Pole Saw (tool only) at $141.26 shipped . Down from $190, since mid-February we’ve seen discounts on this model drop the cost to $180, $170, and $167 before spending a long stretch of September and October down at $150, including during the Prime Day event in that period. The deal here gives you a greater $49 markdown, though, giving you the best price we have tracked in over eight months. You can find its Gen 2 counterpart with a battery discounted on the same page, or head to the brand’s official Amazon storefront here for even more deals.
Bring Worx’s lightweight 2-in-1 Pegasus folding workbench & sawhorse to your project needs down at $100 ($60 off)
